description: Road Safety Camera Network - Compliance Rates Mobile Cameras is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cameras Save Lives. The information shows compliance rates from July 2006 and compares the number of vehicles that pass a camera with the number of fines detected by the camera. All mobile cameras record the number of vehicles assessed. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Cameras Save Lives. Its tags are Cameras Save Lives, Compliance, Fines, Mobile Cameras, Road Safety Camera Network. It offers 3 resource(s) in XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
